name: Honkai: Star Rail
tagline: Working Honkai: Star Rail codes for free Stellar Jade, Credits and upgrade materials.
description: Honkai: Star Rail is HoYoverse's turn-based space-fantasy RPG. The team releases redemption codes during every version livestream (twice per major patch), and ad-hoc codes for milestones and promotional events. Livestream codes are short-lived, often expiring within a day or two, so it's worth redeeming the moment they go live.

redeemSteps.title: Reach Trailblaze Level 10
redeemSteps.detail: Your account must be at least TL 10 to redeem codes. New trailblazers should complete the opening Herta Space Station arc first.

redeemSteps.title: Open the redemption portal
redeemSteps.detail: Visit the official page at hsr.hoyoverse.com/gift. You can also redeem in-game via Phone menu → Profile → Redemption Code (mobile only).

redeemSteps.title: Log in and select your server
redeemSteps.detail: Use your HoYoverse account and pick the correct server: America, Europe, Asia, or TW/HK/MO.

redeemSteps.title: Enter the code
redeemSteps.detail: Type or paste the code exactly. Codes are case-sensitive.

redeemSteps.title: Claim from in-game mail
redeemSteps.detail: Stellar Jade and items arrive in your in-game mailbox within minutes. Mail expires after 30 days.

faq.question: How often do new Honkai: Star Rail codes drop?
faq.answer: Three livestream codes are typically released for each new version (every ~6 weeks). Additional codes appear for milestones, anniversaries and special collaborations.

faq.question: Why is my Honkai: Star Rail code invalid?
faq.answer: Most often the code has expired (livestream codes only last 24–48 hours), you entered it on the wrong server, or there was a typo. Codes are case-sensitive.

faq.question: Can I redeem codes on multiple HoYoverse accounts?
faq.answer: Yes — each HoYoverse account can redeem the same code once. The same physical code cannot be used twice on a single account.

codes.notes: Permanent code, works on every server.
